attributes.board_name: Idaho Board of Social Work Examiners (DOPL)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Board does not pre-approve courses; CE must be germane to social work practice. Online courses germane to social work allowed. Credit also for preparing/providing germane CE or training, individual research projects, and academic courses (15 CE per semester hour, 10 per quarter hour).
rules.carryover: No carryover of excess CE hours.
rules.audit_note: Random audits after renewal; keep proof 4 years. Certificates must be submitted if audited or if renewing after expiration.
rules.notes: 30 hours in the 24 months before renewal. License expiration is the birth date; since October 14, 2025 the board is transitioning from annual to biennial licensure (see DOPL board news).
rules.rule_quote: Every 24 months prior to renewal licensees must complete thirty(30) contact hours of continuing education that includes 2 hours of ethics.
